Maximum Number of Files to Track.displayName: Maximum Number of Files to Track

properties.cleaned_data:
SELECT 
    transaction_id,
    customer_id,
    product,
    ABS(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE)) AS amount,
    "timestamp"
FROM FLOWFILE
WHERE 
    customer_id IS NOT NULL 
    AND customer_id <> '' 
    AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL 
    AND transaction_id NOT LIKE 'CORRUPTED%'
    AND CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
